title: Teal Resume Builder: Design Mode
description:
Unlock the secrets to a standout resume with our ultimate guide to Teal's Resume Builder: Design Mode! 

This videos ensures you'll walk away with a personalized, interview-landing resume, as I take you step-by-step through selecting and customizing a template from our extensive library. We cover everything from font choices to the strategic arrangement of your career history. I'll even teach you how to tweak those pesky date formats and alignments to perfection. If you've ever wondered about the optimal way to showcase your work experience and education.

Step into the world of Teal+, where aesthetics meets efficiency in resume design. We're pushing the envelope with layouts that not only capture your personal brand but also parse well with applicant tracking systems (ATS). I'll take you through the nitty-gritty of creating a resume that's as ATS-friendly as it is eye-catching, ensuring you make a lasting impression. And remember, your feedback fuels our innovation! So, if you've got ideas or insights, our support channel is always open. Get ready to present a professional identity that's as unique as you are, and enhance your job prospects with the latest in resume design tools.
